roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.description: Multi-tenant platform owner managing schools, system health, and global configuration.

roles.name: Director / School Administrator
roles.description: Executive authority over one school institution: academics, staff, finances, and settings.

roles.name: Secretary / Registrar
roles.description: Front desk and admissions processing, student dossiers, legal documents, and justifications.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.description: Classroom instruction, roll-call attendance, grade entry, homework grading, and observations.

roles.name: Accountant / Bursar
roles.description: Tuition fees, installments, invoice generation, payment processing, and financial reporting.

roles.name: Librarian
roles.description: Book catalog, lending circulation, return check-in, and penalty calculation.

roles.name: Parent / Guardian
roles.description: Family portal tracking enrolled children's grades, attendance, homework, and fees.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Learner portal for class schedules, homework submission, grades, and learning strategies.

permissions.description: View system health, uptime, and server metrics
Create, edit, and suspend school tenants
Edit school profile, branding, and grading scales
Assign roles and update permissions matrix
Approve leave requests and staff evaluations
Configure academic years, terms, and sections
Create and edit classes and subject allocations
Edit timetable slots and detect conflicts
View attendance rates and absence logs
Read course materials and download syllabus
Read published learning strategies for child
Verify and approve uploaded legal documents
Generate student ID cards and certificates
View financial ledgers and accounting summaries
Manage overdue accounts and trigger reminders
Record payments and issue official receipts
Configure fee types and discount rules
Process staff payroll and issue payslips
View child tuition invoices and payment receipts
Browse book catalog and circulation status
View active and past book loans
Manage overdue loans and renewal limits
Calculate and settle library overdue fines
View student bus route and meal pass
Send and receive internal direct messages

dataScope.rule: Global platform scope across all school tenants.
Complete school authority across all staff, students, and finances within the institution.
Full student dossier registration, document compliance, and admission records. No financial or grade editing access.
Access strictly limited to assigned classes, subjects, and enrolled students.
Full institutional financial data access. No academic grade or pedagogical record access.
Library catalog and borrowing records only. Guarded by app.features.library.enabled feature flag.
Strictly limited to authenticated guardian's legally linked children.
Access strictly restricted to authenticated student's own enrolled profile.
dataScope.backendEnforcement: SecurityConfig hasRole('ROLE_STUDENT') and SpEL checking principal ID
